inclusionCriteria: Intentional public live camera operated by a known publisher, city, port, park, observatory, tourism board, or EarthCam/explore.org/NASA-class partner.
Official HTTPS YouTube Live embed only. The app constructs youtube-nocookie.com iframe URLs from a validated 11-character video ID.
No raw IP cameras, RTSP, open CCTV dumps, Shodan finds, home/private cams, or camera admin UIs.
Must have a public watch page and a named operator we can attribute on the detail view.
Quality over quantity: scenic or civic value, generally 24/7, currently live at last check.
YouTube Live IDs can rotate when an operator restarts a stream. Update youtubeId if a tile goes stale; keep the same camera id.
